elements.name: q1
elements.title: An icon-only button deletes a draft. Which name communicates its purpose?

elements.name: q2
elements.title: A purely decorative image adds no information. What indicates it can be skipped?

elements.name: q3
elements.title: A chart conveys important trends and values. What is an appropriate alternative?
choices: Identify the chart and provide equivalent information nearby

answer_key.q3: Identify the chart and provide equivalent information nearby

explanations.q1: The name should describe the action.
explanations.q2: An empty alternative indicates decoration; a missing attribute may trigger a fallback.
explanations.q3: The meaningful data and relationships must remain available.
